    AI Overview
    The Boston Celtics vs. Charlotte Hornets game on Sunday, March 29, 2026, at 6 p.m. ET is available on TV via
    NBCS-BOS (Celtics market) and FDSSE (Hornets market). The best way to live stream the game is on Fubo, which provides access to both local channels, or on Peacock. 
    How to Watch Breakdown 
    • Date: Sunday, March 29, 2026
    • Time: 6:00 p.m. ET
    • Venue: Spectrum Center, Charlotte, NC
    • TV Channels: NBC Sports Boston (NBCS-BOS), FanDuel Sports Network South (FDSSE, formerly Bally Sports Southeast)
    • Live Stream: Fubo (regional sports network coverage), Peacock 
    Regional Coverage 
    • Boston Celtics Viewers: Watch on NBC Sports Boston.
    • Charlotte Hornets Viewers: Watch on FanDuel Sports Network Southeast or local options like WSOC-TV. 
    You can also follow the game with live updates and highlights via ESPN.
